title: Table for One.
old_caption:
Flowers for herself, dessert first, karaoke solo. The gossip cloud thinks Libra got stood up, but she's having the best night.
You're not half of anything. Get to know what you love on your own.

title: Agent Double-O-Star.
old_caption: Helicopters, a string quartet, every firework in stock. Then the real wish turns out to be the couch and a good talk. Grand gestures are sweet. Being fully present is sweeter.

title: Supernova.
old_caption:
"Soulmate" on day three, a trip booked by day four. That rush can feel like magic, but things that burn this fast rarely last.
Intensity isn't intimacy. If it's real, it'll still be there on date two.

title: Catch the Wave.
old_caption:
Jealousy, sadness, anxiety. Aries tries to fight, outrun and stop every wave, and wipes out each time.
Feelings come in waves. Let yourself ride them, talk about them, and trust that they pass.

title: Sign Swap.
old_caption:
A planner and a free spirit wake up in each other's signs. Suddenly winging it feels scary and planning feels like care.
When you see the world from their side, the friction makes sense. Every square has a pull.

title: Swipe Fatigue.
old_caption:
Hundreds of swipes, a pile of matches, and nobody you've actually talked to. Endless choice can leave you more tired than connected.
Fewer people, deeper conversations. Slow it down and really meet someone.

title: Take 47.
old_caption: Take 47 of the perfect first date and still no spark. You can't script connection. Drop the performance and bring one good question. Curiosity does what a rehearsed line can't.

title: Unboxing Your Match.
old_caption: Texts back, emotionally available, cries at movies. Great specs. But the chemistry chapter is blank until you meet. A profile is a start. The person is so much more.

title: The water signs group chat.
old_caption:
Ever spiraled over a one-letter "k" text?
The water signs feel it all, then just ask what they meant. Feel it, then say it.

title: We're up.
old_caption: Another "u up?" at 2 AM and never a word at noon. Someone who only appears late at night isn't really showing up. You deserve someone who's present in daylight.
